author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0042380 hydroxymethylbutenyl pyrophosphate reductase activity.
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29701.

To be replaced by the same activity GO:0051745 4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate reductase activity

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 

EcoCyc	UniProtKB:P62623	ispH	PMID:12571359		GO:0042380	hydroxymethylbutenyl pyrophosphate reductase activity	IDA			PANTHER:PTHR30426	20070514		NCBITaxon:83333

Impacted groups: 
EcoCyc 1

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
None.



Thanks.
